title: The Drowned Cousin
text: A cousin of the House, drowned ten years ago and buried with honor, stands at the gate this morning, dripping, asking to come home. They remember everything. They are a little too cold.

options.label: Welcome the drowned cousin home; blood is blood, wet or dry.

outcomes.text: They take up their old room and their old sword, training harder than any of the recruits.
They take up their old room. Within a month the well water tastes of the river, and the House's eldest has taken to sleeping in a chair by the fire.

options.label: Test them with silver and salt to learn what came back from the river.

outcomes.text: They hold the silver without flinching; they are only cold. They stay.
The silver burns them. They go back to the river without a word, and the House mourns them a second time.

options.label: Turn them away at the gate; the House buried them once already.

outcomes.text: They stand at the gate until dark, and then they are gone. The family plot stays wet for a year.
